title: Sherma Totem (HK Silksong)
description: Changes the totem into the Sherma NPC from Silksong.
body: Adds the popular Sherma NPCs from Hollow Knight: Silksong to Minecraft as totems, complete with their voices.![The player holds the totem in their left hand](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/350d1cede427be9db6d8c477a9177d015dc39c4a.png)
